events.title: Brett Eldredge: Glow 10 Year Anniversary Tour
events.addr: 116 Rep. John Lewis Way N, Nashville, TN 37219
events.blurb: Brett Eldredge marks ten years of his Christmas album Glow with three nights at the Ryman.
events.blurbEs: Brett Eldredge celebra diez años de su disco navideño Glow con tres noches en el Ryman.

events.title: Grand Ole Opry
events.blurb: Opry 100 shows Friday and Saturday (Saturday with Steve Earle and Dailey & Vincent), then Opry Country Christmas on Sunday with Tommy Emmanuel and Riders In The Sky.
events.blurbEs: Funciones de Opry 100 el viernes y el sábado (el sábado con Steve Earle y Dailey & Vincent), y Opry Country Christmas el domingo con Tommy Emmanuel y Riders In The Sky.

events.title: Nashville's Nutcracker
events.blurb: Nashville Ballet's holiday production opens with 2 p.m. matinees Friday and Saturday and runs through Dec. 27.
events.blurbEs: La producción navideña de Nashville Ballet se estrena con funciones a las 2 p.m. el viernes y el sábado, y sigue hasta el 27 de diciembre.

events.title: Predators vs. Utah Mammoth
events.blurb: The Preds host Utah in a noon Black Friday matinee. It's a GOLD game, so tickets are sold only to fans in the team's TV region.
events.blurbEs: Los Preds reciben a Utah en un partido de mediodía el Black Friday. Es un partido GOLD: los boletos solo se venden a aficionados de la región televisiva del equipo.

events.title: Vanderbilt vs. Tennessee
events.blurb: The in-state rivalry closes Vanderbilt's regular season with a 6 p.m. kickoff on ESPN. Vanderbilt says the game is sold out.
events.blurbEs: La rivalidad estatal cierra la temporada regular de Vanderbilt con inicio a las 6 p.m. por ESPN. Vanderbilt informa que no quedan boletos.

events.title: Glow Wild at Nashville Zoo
events.blurb: The zoo's new holiday lights event runs nightly through Jan. 3, with Santa on Festival Field starting Friday. Kids under 2 are free.
events.blurbEs: El nuevo evento de luces navideñas del zoológico funciona cada noche hasta el 3 de enero, con Santa en Festival Field desde el viernes. Los menores de 2 años entran gratis.

events.title: Holiday LIGHTS at Cheekwood
events.blurb: Cheekwood's gardens glow with holiday lights nightly from 4:30 to 10 p.m. through Jan. 3, with a holiday marketplace. Kids 2 and under are free.
events.blurbEs: Los jardines de Cheekwood brillan con luces navideñas cada noche de 4:30 a 10 p.m. hasta el 3 de enero, con un mercado navideño. Los niños de 2 años o menos entran gratis.

events.title: Nashville Yards Christmas Tree Lighting
events.blurb: Nashville Yards lights its Christmas tree at 5 p.m. to kick off Holiday Central, with free photos with Santa from 5:30 to 7:30 p.m. Free with RSVP.
events.blurbEs: Nashville Yards enciende su árbol de Navidad a las 5 p.m. para abrir Holiday Central, con fotos gratis con Santa de 5:30 a 7:30 p.m. Gratis con reserva.

events.title: Merry Market
events.blurb: A holiday pop-up market at Nashville Yards, Saturday 4 to 7 p.m. and Sunday noon to 3 p.m. Free with RSVP; the first 100 shoppers each day get a tote bag.
events.blurbEs: Un mercado navideño temporal en Nashville Yards, el sábado de 4 a 7 p.m. y el domingo de 12 a 3 p.m. Gratis con reserva; las primeras 100 personas cada día reciben una bolsa.

events.title: A Country Christmas at Gaylord Opryland
events.blurb: Walk the resort's 43rd A Country Christmas displays and catch the Delta Fountain shows; ICE! featuring Home Alone and other attractions are ticketed.
events.blurbEs: Recorre la decoración de la 43.ª edición de A Country Christmas en el resort y mira los espectáculos de la Delta Fountain; ICE! con Home Alone y otras atracciones requieren boleto.
